items.text: Summer and vacation courses for students are best used to try one new skill or area in a low-risk way, such as coding, writing, design, a language or a trade, so choose by curiosity and a small deliverable and avoid long, costly programmes sold on fear.
Check content, cost and refund terms and avoid guarantees.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
